thread:
elaine: Pushed a small PR updating the Mariner-9B model card. Two quick things I bumped into while writing: the limits table still lists max_seq=12k (theoretical) and the examples folder uses the old SDK pattern. Can we sync?

rob: Nice. For CLI examples, we've been standardizing on `rw models` plural. Replace any `rw model set-limit` usage with:
```bash
# set soft token limit for mariner-9b
rw models limits update --model mariner-9b --max-tokens 6000
```

pete: Also saw the bench link points to the legacy CSV at s3://redwood-docs/bench/mariner/v1/throughput.csv. Bench infra now publishes JSON at https://bench.redwood.ai/mariner-9b/v2/report.json. Update the href so the throughput row renders.

anika: Compatibility note: the card currently says "quantized: CPU OK" which is misleading. Per infra, mariner quant profiles only fit on 32GB CPU instances. Recommend changing to: "quantized: GPU supported; CPU quant requires >=32GB and is not guaranteed." I'll add that sentence.

ci-bot: CI: docs build failed - linkcheck error: /docs/catalog/mariner-9b#benchmarks -> 404 (old CSV link)

elainE: small typo in my original commit name fixed. pushing patch to swap link and adjust limits table to show "12k theoretical, 6k recommended" and a short note about kv-cache.

rob: For SDK examples, v2 uses `client.text.generate(model=..., input=...)` not `client.generate(model_id=..., prompt=...)`. Example replacement:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.text.generate(model="mariner-9b", input=prompt)
print(resp.output_text)
```

pete: I updated the sample output block to reflect resp.output_text and corrected the code fence. Ran `make linkcheck` locally - passes. Pushed commit.

ci-bot: CI: re-run queued.

ci-bot: CI: build passed. preview: https://deploy-preview-1402--docs.redwood.ai/catalog/mariner-9b

anika: Preview looks good. The compatibility note reads clearly and the throughput row populates from the JSON.

elaine: Thanks all. I'll merge after a quick staging smoke test. Also adding a one-line changelog entry: "docs: mariner-9b - fix bench link, update limits & SDK/CLI snippets, clarify quant support."

rob: Good call. I'll follow up with a tiny README entry in examples/ explaining the resp.output_text change so folks upgrading the SDK see it.

elaine: Perfect. If infra reruns the bench and numbers shift, we can adjust the table in a follow-up PR.
